requirement_evidence.quote: I want `pyromat.get(idstr: str) -> object` so application code can retrieve one already-loaded substance from the PYroMat catalog by its exact substance ID. For example, after `import pyromat as pm`, `pm.get("ig.O2")` should return the oxygen substance object whose `sid()` is `"ig.O2"` and whose `pmclass()` is `"ig2"`; `pm.get("mp.H2O")` should return the multiphase water substance object whose `sid()` is `"mp.H2O"` and whose `pmclass()` is `"mp1"`.
